verdict.rationale: Semgrep Assistant is documented as doing contextual AI post-processing to reduce noise (~20%), and independent evidence shows a real-world use of Semgrep SARIF output plus LLM prompting to triage/prioritize the most interesting findings at Microsoft. However, deduplication and explicit false-positive flagging are not clearly documented, and one report notes an LLM hallucinating semgrep functions, indicating imperfect AI reliability. Missing for 10: first-party documentation detailing deduplication logic and false-positive classification, more robust independent corroboration of Assistant's triage accuracy, and confirmation the AI triage runs natively rather than via external DIY pipelines.
